# Aukmind

> Senior software and robotics engineering practice offering fractional
> CTO services, technical due diligence, end-to-end product development,
> research, and training. Backed by a vetted partner network of senior
> specialists across data analytics, embedded systems, hardware,
> mechanical, robotics, AI and cloud.

## About

Aukmind is a consultancy and engineering practice founded by Alexis
Paques, a senior robotics and systems engineer working professionally since
2015, including engineering leadership at Corvus Robotics. The
legal entity was incorporated in 2025 to consolidate a long-standing
engineering practice.

Aukmind works with startups, scale-ups, and medium-sized companies that
need experienced technical leadership or senior engineering capacity
without hiring full-time. Engagements are senior-led.

- Website: https://aukmind.com
- Contact: alexis@aukmind.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/aukmind
- GitHub: https://github.com/aukmind

## Partner network

Aukmind draws on a vetted network of senior partners to cover the full
product lifecycle. Partner disciplines include:

- Data analytics, data science, business intelligence
- Embedded systems and firmware
- Hardware engineering and electronics
- Mechanical design and mechatronics
- Robotics (ROS/ROS2, autonomous systems)
- AI and machine learning
- Cloud infrastructure and DevOps
- Full-stack software delivery

## Services

- Fractional tech leadership (CTO)
- Technical due diligence
- Technical consulting
- End-to-end product and software development
- Research and benchmarking studies
- Training in robotics, C++, Rust, and Python

## Core expertise

Robotics, ROS/ROS2, embedded systems, hardware-software integration,
AI and ML systems, data analytics, dashboards and data visualisation, C++, Rust, Python, software
architecture, and technical due diligence.

## Free tools

Browser-only tools at https://aukmind.com/tools.html. Files never leave the device.

- Image Toolbox (tools.html#image): convert HEIC, compress, resize, crop, blur, metadata, watermark
- PDF Editor (tools.html#pdf): merge, reorder, edit, sign, convert PDFs
- LinkedIn Text (tools.html#linkedin): bold and italic text for LinkedIn posts
